sources.title: MIVUBI Interactive Block and Container State Policy v1

facts.subject: interactive world object
facts.statement: Every gameplay-critical block object should declare an object-state contract covering dimension/location, block type, required permutation states, relevant components, inventory/container expectations, automation coupling, and owning arenaGeneration.

facts.subject: critical block verification
facts.statement: Do not treat matching block type as sufficient proof. Verify required permutation state such as open/closed, facing, upper/lower half, powered state, or project-defined state when gameplay depends on it.

facts.subject: container baseline
facts.statement: Arena-owned containers must declare expected baseline contents and reset policy. Structure restore, script fill, loot insertion, player access, and hopper/dispenser automation must converge to that baseline before arena reuse.

facts.subject: container interaction
facts.statement: When container content is transaction-critical, opening/interaction should be scoped to current player/session/arena ownership and concurrent writers must arbitrate access or reconcile on close; cleanup must not overwrite an active valid transaction blindly.

facts.subject: door gate route state
facts.statement: Doors, gates, trapdoors, bridges, and similar route objects must feed their actual block permutation state into navigation/route verification. Visual presence of the expected block type is not enough to mark a route open.

facts.subject: redstone/interactive block coupling
facts.statement: If an interactive object participates in redstone or command automation, changes to its permutation/component state invalidate affected automation-graph assumptions and require re-verification.

facts.subject: structure restored object
facts.statement: After structure restoration, re-read interactive block permutation/component/container state from the world instead of assuming the saved structure restored the exact logical state required by the current arena generation.

facts.subject: block reference lifetime
facts.statement: After world mutation, chunk unload/reload, or deferred callbacks, reacquire critical Block and container/component references before mutation or verification rather than relying on stale handles.

facts.subject: container reward contents
facts.statement: If a chest/barrel/container holds gameplay rewards, its fill/claim/reset path must share rewardOperationId or equivalent idempotency with loot/economy logic so structure restore or reset cannot duplicate claimable value.

facts.subject: arena reset interactive objects
facts.statement: Arena reset verification should include expected block type, permutation, component state, container contents, open/powered state, and automation readiness for all declared critical interactive objects.

facts.subject: critical object unavailable
facts.statement: If a critical interactive object cannot be read because its chunk is unloaded or location invalid, treat its state as unknown and fail closed or load/retry within bounded policy. Do not assume its last known state remains current.
